verdict.rationale: The docs say CDP abstracts chain mechanics: stablecoin checkout "without onchain complexity" with no gas fees for payers, CDP handling signing and broadcasting, and custodial deposit addresses that auto-credit balances. Developers work through an API surface (a CLI exposing every API endpoint, plus HTTP webhooks) and the official cdp-sdk client libraries. Missing for 10: explicit REST API reference evidence (OpenAPI spec probes all 404), the specific languages the client libraries support, explicit statements that node operation is abstracted, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
